STRATA TITLES ACT 1985

STRATA TITLES (FEDERAL TERRITORY OF KUALA LUMPUR) (AMENDMENT) RULES 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 81 of the Strata Titles Act 1985 [Act 318]
read together with subsection 5(5), the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Strata Titles (Federal Territory Of Kuala
Lumpur) (Amendment) Rules 2020.

           (2)  These Rules are deemed to have come into operation on 1 January 2020.
